subject: 二层黄衣立胁侍
prompt:
Create ONE high-resolution photorealistic reference-guided reconstruction of the SINGLE specific Yingxian Wooden Pagoda sculpture in the attached reference, not a generic Buddhist statue. Neutral light-gray seamless studio backdrop, soft even diffuse illumination, sharp face and exact fingers, all in focus. Preserve the exact sculpted facial proportions, eyes, smile, body pose, garment folds, headdress, number of arms, hand positions and visible iconographic details of this specific reference. Material is realistic handmade ancient painted clay sculpture, mineral pigments and gilding, NEVER living human skin, wax, glossy plastic or cartoon/CGI. Clear shape separation suitable for 3D modeling. Isolate from temple, other figures, columns, halos not actually present, offerings and photographic clutter. No captions, lettering, watermark, panels or collage. Image is an AI interpretation, not documentary evidence; metadata outside image will say this. Subject-specific visual observations: Slender crowned standing attendant, pale worn face black brows red lips, small red gold crown green central jewel. Brown red shoulder wrap, chest collar with green curled scroll, blue abdominal garment, bright yellow apron panel and long red skirt, long trailing ribbons at both sides. RIGHT hand viewer LEFT cupped at waist, LEFT hand viewer RIGHT lower at hip palm up reaching outward. Exactly TWO arms. Include bare feet and small lotus platform.
PRESENT-CONDITION reconstruction: faithfully retain the original observed weathering, worn gilding, exposed ground, discoloration, chips and faded paint distribution. Improve frontal clarity and recover visible shapes without beautifying or renewing the surface. Weathered patches must stay comparable to the reference.
